item.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Clampett City
item.description: Because Mammoth Pictures is losing money, Drysdale decides to tear down the studio and turn it into Clampett City. The Clampetts are excited about getting a town and streets named after them, and when they go to explore their town, they come to a Western set, which they fall in love with.

item.title: The Brady Bunch - Getting Davy Jones
item.description: Marcia makes a promise that she will get Davy Jones to perform at the prom. It's a promise she quickly learns is going to be very difficult to keep, since trying to get ahold of the singer is all but impossible.

item.title: The Brady Bunch - Click
item.description: Greg wants to be on the football team, but Carol is against it, fearing that he's going to get hurt - which of course he does. Can he and his camera still find a way to help out the team?

item.title: Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom - Chacma Country Part II
item.description: "The chacma baboon has many homes. Marlin and Jim explore all of ‘chacma country’ from the lush coastal areas to the semi-desert interiors of South Africa."

item.title: Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom - Chacma Country Part I
item.description: "Marlin and Jim visit South Africa to study and photograph the chacma baboons in their natural environment and to conduct some fascinating experiments."

item.title: Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom - Mysteries of the Wild
item.description: "Many mysteries of the wild present a challenge to seek the answer. In this episode Jim Fowler brings to the viewer some of the most memorable scenes ever captured on film."

item.title: Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom - Bobcat Kingdom
item.description: "Marlin and Jim observe a family of bobcats in the Zion Canyon area in the Utah wilderness."

item.title: Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom - Tale of the Fox
item.description: "This is the tale of the fox cub as it explores the wild kingdom for the first time in the North Woods of Wisconsin."

item.title: Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom - Bayou Backwaters
item.description: "Marlin and Jim journey by flat-bottomed boat into the uncharted, moss-covered silence of the Louisiana bayou country on an animal collecting trip."

item.title: The Life and Times of Grizzly Adams - The Skyrider
item.description: "Adams and Mad Jack find an unusual man. Mr. Milton Wright's trying to achieve human flight in his bird-like "glider" invention. S close watch is kept on him. He keeps crashing but also needs to find the answer to realizing his dream."
